_meta.note: The live catalogue. Seven active products, all in dates-nuts (Ajwa/Medjool/Sukkari dates, Afghan figs, the dry fruit & nut mix, pistachios and cashews). The other thirteen — honey, saffron, oregano, oils and ghee — are "active": false: their categories were parked in the launch reshuffle and a product whose category is off has nowhere to live. They are kept in full so re-listing one is a single boolean. getAllProducts() in modules/catalog/backend/api.js filters on this flag, and every other read goes through it, so an inactive product is absent from category pages, search, suggestions, deals, related rails and the home shelves alike. Fields map 1:1 onto GET /api/products (shared/backend/api-contract.md).
_meta.barcodeNote: MOCK EAN-13 codes (valid check digit, not GS1-registered) — replace with the real supplier barcodes before launch. tools/gen-sourcing-facts.py verifies every check digit.
